Class NetworkNode

java.lang.Object
base.NetworkNode
Direct Known Subclasses:
ActiveAgent, DataCell
public abstract class NetworkNode extends Object
Abstract base class for all entities on the simulation grid.

      protected Color getHealthColor(Color baseColor, Color deadColor)
      Changes between two colors based on remaining HP.

    • infect

      public void infect(int damage)
      Deals damage to this node, corrupting it if HP reaches zero.
      Parameters:
      damage - amount of HP to subtract

    • repair

      public boolean repair(int repairSpeed)
      Progresses repair on this node by the given speed. A corrupted node must accumulate repairThreshold worth of progress before it comes back; a node that is merely damaged has its health restored directly.
      Parameters:
      repairSpeed - amount of repair applied this tick
      Returns:
      true if the node just reached full health, false if still in progress
